settingsEnabledDesc: When off, all gesture recognition and visual effects are disabled.
settingsSuppressionKeyDesc: Hold this key while right-clicking to skip gestures and show the normal menu.
settingsActivationDistanceDesc: How far you must move the mouse while holding right-click before gesture recognition starts.
settingsTimeoutMsDesc: If you hold right-click longer than this without finishing a gesture, it is cancelled. Set 0 for no limit.
settingsDirectionModeDesc: 4 directions = up/down/left/right; 8 directions also includes the four diagonals.
settingsSampleDistanceDesc: Spacing between sampled points. Smaller values track the path more closely but are more sensitive.
settingsSimplifyToleranceDesc: Controls how much the path is smoothed. Larger values produce a smoother trail.
settingsMinimumSegmentLengthDesc: Movements shorter than this are ignored, to avoid recognising tiny jitter.
settingsTurnAngleThresholdDesc: A direction change larger than this starts a new direction segment.
settingsMaximumSegmentsDesc: Gestures with more than this many direction segments are ignored.
settingsShowTrailDesc: Draw the mouse trail on the screen.
settingsShowHintDesc: Show the recognised directions and the command that will run, in real time.
settingsBindingsDesc: Enable or disable the four default bindings. Editing directions, adding new bindings, or recording custom gestures will arrive in a later stage.
settingsExportDesc: Download the current configuration as a JSON file.
settingsImportDesc: Replace the current configuration from a JSON file. The import is validated before being applied.
settingsResetDesc: Reset every field and binding to its default value.
settingsResetConfirm: Restore all settings to their defaults? This cannot be undone.
bindingErrorTooMany: Gesture has too many segments — make it shorter
bindingEmpty: No bindings yet — add one with the button above.
gestureRecorderTooShort: Trail too short — draw a longer one
gestureRecorderHint: Hold the right button and draw a gesture
gestureRecorderTooMany: Gesture too long — make it shorter
bindingErrorDiagonal4: Diagonals are not supported in 4-direction mode
